mainText: Palo Alto Networks confirms attacks on exposed firewall management interfaces. Check exposure, restrict access and apply the correct fixes. Drupal confirms a separate installer flaw is being exploited. Upgrade, run the database update and review administrator changes. 1Password reports stolen account metadata, while saying vault contents and protection keys were unaffected. Verify notifications and watch for recovery phishing. In Guadeloupe, an earlier hospital cyberattack continues to affect scheduled care. Healthcare teams should check downtime procedures. No named customer product use or compromise was confirmed. Focus on exposed management, website recovery checks and trusted identity verification.
